posts.text:
I have jumbled thoughts on the Hank Green AI "scandal," but the primary one is that regardless of your views on the *morality* of AI, you can't rely on it too much purely to maintain individuality

I already have ChatGPT. If I want its opinion, I can ask it myself. You must deliver something *else*
